summary_1line: Counsel on righteous kingship and sacrifice is followed by Yudhishthira’s grief and Vyasa’s teaching that Time governs human gains and losses.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Hayagriva stands alone on a blood-soaked battlefield, drawing his bow as robbers surround him while fallen foes lie around his chariot.
The battle imagined as a ritual sacrifice: Hayagriva’s chariot as the altar, arrows flying like ladles pouring blood as ghee into the fire of war.
Yudhishthira stands before Vyasa amid mourning widows, lowering his head as he confesses that kingship brings him no joy after the war.
